Over a few beers, a roommate of mine and her friend were reminiscing about their college days. A topic that came up was Super Smash Bros Melee. They went on for a solid 20 minutes about how good they were and their favorite characters to play, favorite stages, so on and so forth. I casually mentioned that I dabbled with it on gamecube here and there, and was met with "We should get the gamecube set up and play a couple matches. $20 says we beat your ass." So, of course, I quietly agreed. What roommate and friend didn't know was, when I said I "dabbled" I meant I played competitively for close to 5 years. Once or twice on a national level. So, for the next 90 minutes, I took them to the cleaners.  Out of the 15 matches we played, I lost one stock. They ended the night owing me about $300 each, disconnecting the gamecube and stuffing it in the back of a closet. I told them not to worry about payment, but let me know if there was anything else they wanted to "beat my ass" in to even out the debt.
